method: Single-worker pre-routing labels from local merged diffs and the catalog capabilities plus canonical skill trigger contracts at fadac1fcf606b250906204f07a13b686d9c5653c. Neither router has been run on these eight PRs. This is a purposive held-out sample, not an independent blind reviewer or a random sample.
labelPolicy: Select a skill for changed behavior in its contract, not for every touched path or every topic mentioned in verification prose. Ordinary correctness tests inherit their domain; quality is additionally expected for substantial cross-layer test coverage, accessibility automation or runner reliability. Release witness is not expected merely because a PR body lists verification. Security-only sanitization does not imply a new block contract, backend design or reader presentation.

cases.selectionReason: Sanitization crosses media persistence, owner input and reader projection without changing their domain contracts; tests a broad-path over-selection risk.

expected.rationale: safeHref is extracted and applied to upload, import, media storage and the legacy asset-credit fallback; unsafe stored URLs become plain text. The change is URL sanitization, explicitly handed off by reader/editorial/backend skills.
